title: An Auditable Public-Data Framework for Prioritizing Biomarker-Matched Drug Hypotheses Across Benchmark and Rare Urologic Cancers: analysis code and result tables
description:
Analysis code, fitted differential-expression tables, enrichment tables, the association table with per-row scoring provenance, the candidate-selection table, the candidate denominator, the prior-proposal audit and the figure-generation code supporting Brinkley, Greenberg and Caso.

The pipeline runs end to end from this deposit. Large third-party primary data (the GEO series, the HGNC table, the DepMap and PRISM matrices) are re-downloaded by the first scripts rather than mirrored here.

Two limits of the audit trail are recorded in the deposit itself: the gene-to-druggable-target mapping behind the frozen candidate set was performed by hand and its query log was not retained, and the prior-proposal audit was performed by one author without duplicate review.
